title: Traditional Turkish Bread
description: Soft, slightly chewy, and baked to a golden finish with a traditional sesame and nigella seed topping.

ingredients.notes: divided: 225g for Pre-Ferment, 240g for Main Dough
divided: 145ml for Pre-Ferment, 165ml for Main Dough
divided: 1.5g for Pre-Ferment, 5g for Main Dough
divided: 3g for Pre-Ferment, 7g for Main Dough

method.instruction: Make the pre-ferment: in a bowl, combine 225 g of the bread flour, 145 ml of the lukewarm water, 1.5 g of the salt, and 3 g of the yeast. Mix until smooth. Cover and let rest at room temperature for 2–3 hours, or refrigerate overnight.
In a large bowl, combine the remaining 240 g of bread flour, the remaining 5 g of salt, the remaining 7 g of yeast, and 2 g of malt powder.
Add the pre-ferment, the remaining 165 ml of lukewarm water, and 8 ml of olive oil.
Mix until a rough dough forms, then knead for 8–10 minutes by hand or 6–7 minutes in a stand mixer until smooth, soft, and elastic.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise in a warm place for 1–1½ hours until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and divide into 2 equal portions, approximately 400 g each.
Shape each portion into a ball, cover, and let rest for 10 minutes to relax the gluten.
On a lightly floured surface, roll or stretch each ball into an oval or round shape, about 25–30 cm long and 1–1.5 cm thick.
Place shaped breads on lined baking trays. Using your fingertips, gently dimple the surface all over to create the characteristic texture.
Cover and let rise for 20–30 minutes until slightly puffy.
Brush the tops lightly with water or olive oil. Sprinkle generously with sesame seeds and nigella seeds.
Bake for 12–15 minutes until golden brown with a soft interior and slightly crisp exterior.
Cool on a wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

notes.title: Pre-Ferment Benefits
notes.content: The pre-ferment develops flavour and creates a softer, more open crumb. It is worth the extra time — this is what gives the bread its characteristic texture.

notes.title: Nigella Seeds
notes.content: Nigella seeds are strongly recommended for authentic Turkish flavour and visual appeal. They add a subtle, slightly bitter, onion-like taste.

notes.title: Flour Choice
notes.content: Laucke Mulgara Baker's flour is recommended for its protein content and performance, but any quality bread flour will work.

notes.title: Serving Suggestion
notes.content: Perfect for kebabs, doner wraps, or torn and served alongside dips like hummus, baba ganoush, or labneh.
